text: Handling deadlines well starts with good time management. First, look at everything you need to do and decide what is most important. This prioritization helps you focus on tasks that really matter, so you don't waste time on small things. It is also smart to manage your scope: if a task is too big, break it into smaller parts or agree on what you can realistically finish. Finally, communication is key. If you see that you might miss a deadline, tell your team or your teacher early. They can often help you, and they will appreciate your honesty. With these simple habits, deadlines become much less stressful.
